mapper.select: SELECT mc.id AS memberCouponId, c.name, c.discount_type AS discountType, c.discount_value AS discountValue, c.minimum_order_amount AS minimumOrderAmount, c.maximum_discount_amount AS maximumDiscountAmount, mc.status, mc.issued_at AS issuedAt, c.expires_at AS expiresAt FROM member_coupons mc INNER JOIN coupons c ON c.id = mc.coupon_id WHERE mc.member_id = #{memberId} AND mc.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.starts_at <= NOW(6) AND c.expires_at > NOW(6) ORDER BY mc.issued_at DESC, mc.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_coupons mc INNER JOIN coupons c ON c.id = mc.coupon_id WHERE mc.member_id = #{memberId} AND mc.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.starts_at <= NOW(6) AND c.expires_at > NOW(6)
